description: This file defines a JavaScript class 'CompanyDetailsDialog' and related functions for creating and displaying a customizable dialog box in a web interface, specifically for showing company details within the SuiteCRM application.

classes.name: CompanyDetailsDialog
classes.description: A class for creating and managing a company details dialog box in the SuiteCRM web interface.

methods.name: setHeader
methods.description: Sets the header text of the dialog.

methods.name: setFooter
methods.description: Sets the footer text of the dialog.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Creates and displays the dialog with specified properties.
